newsitem.title: INDONESIA: At least 11 dead in Indonesian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 11 dead in Indonesian plane crash.

text.p: At least 11 people died and 21 were missing after an Indonesian Fokker aircraft crashed on Thursday near the West Java town of Bandung, a rescue official said.
"Eleven people died, 18 were saved and the rest of the 50 people on board are not yet accounted for," the official in the Bandung office of the National Search and Rescue organisation told Reuters.
Police had earlier said there were 46 passengers and five crew aboard the Dutch-made twin-engined F27 turboprop plane bound for Jakarta.
An airport official at Bandung's Husein Sastranegara airport said the Sempati Airlines plane crashed about 13 km (eight miles) from Bandung some nine minutes after take-off.
The official Antara news agency said the plane went down at the Margahayu Permai housing complex in the Bandung regency, but there was no immediate word on casualties on the ground.
Officials said there were delays in reaching the site because of heavy holiday traffic on the roads around the hill city of Bandung.
Thursday was a national holiday in mainly-Moslem Indonesia marking the birthday of the Prophet Muhammad.
